decision_cruda.rationale: LH-03 repair is estimated at 09:45 to 10:00 (likely 09:54), and the radio and CMMS agree. The nearest loader, LH-08, needs 0.33 h to reach E543-07 and would arrive about 09:50. That is almost when LH-03 is back, so it would add under 1 oz. It would also cost the 0.4 oz/h of infrastructure development plus the return trip. Este has truck spare capacity but the stope's ore stays in place and is loaded after the repair. No moves are justified.

LH-03 is down at TJ-E543-07 (radio and CMMS agree). The revised repair estimate puts it back at 14:30 at the earliest, likely 15:30. The stope holds 307 t at 8.3 g/t and has no loader. LH-10 is free at the workshop, 0.49 h away, and costs no production or development hours. Este is not truck-limited (inflow 24 against 72 t/h capacity). LH-10 mucks at 25.4 t/h for about 6 h of loading time (0.5 h before 11:00, then 11:30 to 17:00), roughly 150 t, or about 40 oz. I took no loaders from development headings or producing stopes.
